metric: Unsafe-rewrite pairs from the fuzzing suite that may differ (NOT IN versus anti-join, outer-join filters, COUNT over empty input, join duplicates, UNION versus INTERSECT or a join) treated as faulty variants; one random seed catches 322/340, 8 random databases 340/340, the suite 340/340 (including union-intersect-5, which needs NULLs in both tables).
correctness: Each kill repeats on both sides on a database; the pairs are the fuzzing thread's committed cases (tests/fixtures/unsafe_rewrite_cases.jsonl, expect either/different).
held_out: the fixture's held-out families are included in the 51 and scored the same way
caveats: Easy for every strategy but one seed; the gain is size: median counterexample 2 rows for the suite versus 25 for 8 random databases. Pairs the fixture marks equivalent are not faults and are skipped. 50 of these were minimized and replayed (median 2 rows kept, 151 to 91 rows total).
